verses.english: “Mendicants, develop limitless immersion, alert and mindful.

verses.pali: Samādhiṁ, bhikkhave, bhāvayataṁ appamāṇaṁ nipakānaṁ patissatānaṁ pañca ñāṇāni paccattaññeva uppajjanti.
verses.english: When you develop limitless immersion, alert and mindful, five knowledges arise for you personally.

verses.pali: ‘Ayaṁ samādhi paccuppannasukho ceva āyatiñca sukhavipāko’ti paccattaññeva ñāṇaṁ uppajjati,
verses.english: ‘This immersion is blissful now, and results in bliss in the future.’ …

verses.pali: ‘ayaṁ samādhi ariyo nirāmiso’ti paccattaññeva ñāṇaṁ uppajjati,
verses.english: ‘This immersion is noble and not of the flesh.’ …
‘This immersion is not cultivated by reprobates.’ …

verses.pali: ‘ayaṁ samādhi santo paṇīto paṭippassaddhaladdho ekodibhāvādhigato, na sasaṅkhāraniggayhavāritagato’ti paccattaññeva ñāṇaṁ uppajjati,
verses.english: ‘This immersion is peaceful and sublime and tranquil and unified, not held in place by forceful suppression.’ …

verses.pali: ‘sato kho panāhaṁ imaṁ samāpajjāmi sato vuṭṭhahāmī’ti paccattaññeva ñāṇaṁ uppajjati.
verses.english: ‘I mindfully enter into and emerge from this immersion.’ …

verses.pali: Samādhiṁ, bhikkhave, bhāvetha appamāṇaṁ nipakā patissatā.
verses.english: Develop limitless immersion, alert and mindful.

verses.pali: Samādhiṁ, bhikkhave, bhāvayataṁ appamāṇaṁ nipakānaṁ patissatānaṁ imāni pañca ñāṇāni paccattaññeva uppajjantī”ti.
verses.english: When you develop limitless immersion, alert and mindful, these five knowledges arise for you personally.”
